quote: “As you set out for Ithaka / hope the voyage is a long one, / full of adventure, full of discovery.”
source: C. P. Cavafy, Ithaka, lines 1 to 3, Collected Poems (trans. Edmund Keeley and Philip Sherrard, Princeton University Press, 1975)

evidence.where: E-Verse Radio transcription of the Keeley and Sherrard translation in the 1975 wording; the Poetry Foundation prints the 1992 revision (copyright 1975, 1992) which reads hope your road is a long one
evidence.edition: C. P. Cavafy: Collected Poems, trans. Edmund Keeley and Philip Sherrard, ed. George Savidis (Princeton University Press, 1975)
evidence.locator: lines 1 to 3, the opening of the poem, written 1911

reason: The opening three lines in the 1975 Keeley and Sherrard wording, which the 1992 revised edition changed to hope your road is a long one; the citation names the 1975 edition whose wording ships.
